exclusion_rule: Candidates excluded from each real event's window [-5, +20]. Pool filtered to same calendar month, different year, vol ratio <= 3.0 (20-session realised vol).
note: Kolari-Pynnonen (2010) is uninformative in this single-index design (mean pairwise residual correlation 0.998 for returns, 1.000 for volume). This randomization test provides the correct reference distribution for CAAR/CAAV at horizons 1, 5, 10, 20 trading sessions.
